images.title: Perseverance's first high-resolution Mastcam-Z panorama
images.instrument: Mastcam-Z right-eye zoom camera, 110 mm mosaic
images.location: Octavia E. Butler landing site, Jezero Crater
images.note: NASA's documented Sol 4 panorama of the rover landing site. Its camera position has not been shown to match any MarsPath candidate marker or destination. The mosaic is a preliminary calibrated natural-color composite.
